extracted.intended_audience: Researchers who want to submit preprints to Peer Community In (PCI), potential PCI recommenders, and people looking for PCI subject communities or contact information.
extracted.subtask_description: A directory page listing current Peer Community In (PCI) subject communities and basic contact/navigation links for submitting preprints, becoming a recommender, or creating/endorsing PCIs. It is not a review rubric but an informational index for presubmission pathways via HAL and related PCI actions.
